semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in digital mixed-signal test equipment for semiconductors.
summary: HangZhou Speedcury Technology Co., Ltd. is a prominent provider of digital mixed-signal test systems, leveraging advanced technologies such as FPGA design and high-speed communication. The company has developed China's first high-performance digital mixed-signal test system solution, significantly advancing the domestic semiconductor testing landscape.

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Hangzhou, China, and has contributed to the domestic semiconductor industry's development.
